needed.evidence: The left side of the road is lined with parked cars directly against the building, with no visible sidewalk or footway for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated, paved sidewalk on the left side of the road, separating the pedestrian path from the vehicle lane.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road is also used for parking, with no separate footway visible for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated, paved sidewalk on the right side of the road, separating the pedestrian path from the vehicle lane.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the residential and commercial nature of the street, but no marked or unmarked crossing facilities are visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing (zebra crossing) at a logical point, such as near the junction or in front of the main building entrances.

needed.evidence: No street lights are visible along the road in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for both pedestrians and drivers, especially during evening hours.
